intro: Drusilla La Salle is a human warlock trainer situated in the shadowed graveyard outside Northshire Abbey. Operating on the fringes of the Holy Order of Northshire, she mentors fledgling spellcasters in the dark arts of summoning and shadow. When forbidden knowledge slips beyond the abbey walls, she does not hesitate to use opportunism and dark magic to claim it.

p: While paladins and priests practice beneath the stained glass of Northshire Abbey, Drusilla La Salle remains outdoors among the headstones of the graveyard. Practicing demonology and fel magic is deeply taboo within the kingdom of Stormwind, forcing warlocks to dwell on the periphery of polite society. Drusilla provides early instruction to novice warlocks who have received tainted correspondence, teaching them how to harness shadow power without drawing the immediate wrath of abbey authorities.
